info.title: Harness daemon API
info.description: REST API served by the Harness daemon (harness-daemon). The API is dual-transport: most endpoints mirror a WebSocket JSON-RPC method, recorded per operation as the `x-websocket-method` extension. Generated from annotated handlers - do not edit docs/api/openapi.json by hand; regenerate with `mise run openapi:generate`.

AcpAgentHandshake.description: Result of the ACP `initialize` exchange with a live agent process.

AcpAgentInspectSnapshotSchema.description: Wire shape of the ACP inspect snapshot.

AcpAgentSessionState.description: Live per-session agent state assembled from ACP session notifications.

last_stop_reason.description: Why the most recent prompt turn stopped, as reported by the agent.

AcpAgentSnapshotSchema.description: Wire shape of a live ACP managed-agent snapshot.

AcpAgentStartRequestSchema.description:
Wire shape of the ACP agent start request. The descriptor is named
`descriptor_id` on the wire, not `agent`.

AcpEndpoint.description:
A remote ACP endpoint the daemon connects to instead of spawning a child.

The URL scheme selects the transport: `ws`/`wss` uses WebSocket, `http`/
`https` uses SSE with POST. Only header names and the environment variables
holding their values cross the wire; the daemon resolves the values at
connect time so a token never rides the request. `headers_env` applies only
to `http`/`https` endpoints - the WebSocket transport drops request headers,
so the daemon rejects headers set on a `ws`/`wss` endpoint.

AcpMcpServer.description:
One MCP server a descriptor offers to its agent.

Mirrors the ACP `McpServer` shape without depending on the SDK, so the
catalog and daemon wire format stay independent of the protocol crate.

AcpPermissionBatchSchema.description: Wire shape of a pending ACP permission batch.

AcpSessionConfigOptionState.description: Compact view of one advertised session config option and its value.

AcpSessionListPage.description: One page of `session/list` results, carrying the agent's opaque cursor.

AcpSessionSummary.description:
One session an agent reports from `session/list`.

Distinct from a harness session: the agent owns these ids and may report
sessions harness never started, so callers treat the list as display data
rather than a source of harness session state.

message.description:
Compatibility summary for clients that still expect a single-line prompt
message.

AgentPersona.description: A predefined agent definition that shapes an agent's role and focus.

description.description: What this persona does, shown in detail views.

AgentStatusSchema.description: Serialized agent status: a bare status string or a disconnected object.

AgentTuiInput.description: Structured keyboard-like input sent into the PTY master.

AgentTuiInputRequestSchema.description:
Documented wire shape of [`AgentTuiInputRequest`], which hand-rolls its serde
through `RawAgentTuiInputRequest`. Exactly one of `input` or `sequence` is
accepted; the validation lives in the handler, so the schema documents both
as optional.

AgentTuiInputSequence.description: Ordered keyboard-like input replayed into an active terminal agent.

AgentTuiInputSequenceStep.description: One timed input step replayed into an active terminal agent.

AgentTuiKey.description: Named keyboard input supported by the headless TUI steering API.

ArbitrationOutcome.description:
Leader arbitration result for a task that exhausted the three-round
review cycle with outstanding disputed points.

AskUserQuestionPrompt.description: An `AskUserQuestion` prompt with header, options, multi-select.

AwaitingReview.description:
Metadata attached when a worker submits a task for review and the task
returns to the queue awaiting a reviewer claim.

queued_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the task entered the awaiting-review state.

required_consensus.description: Number of distinct-runtime reviewers required to close consensus.

submitter_agent_id.description: Agent id of the worker that submitted for review.

summary.description: Optional summary text the worker attached on submission.

allow_custom_model.description:
When `true`, the `model` field is accepted as-is without catalog
validation and any effort value is forwarded without checking the
model's `effort_values`.

effort.description:
Optional reasoning effort level (e.g. `low`, `medium`, `high`,
`xhigh`). Forwarded to the codex app-server `turn/start` payload as
`effort` and ignored when the selected model does not support reasoning.

model.description:
Optional model identifier validated against the codex catalog. `None`
means use the runtime default selected by the codex app-server.

effort.description: Optional reasoning effort forwarded to the codex app-server turn context.

model.description:
Optional model identifier passed to the codex app-server for the thread
and turn context.

DaemonErrorBody.description:
Error envelope returned by daemon handlers on failure.

Mirrors the dominant shape produced by `error_status_and_body`
(`{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`). A few endpoints emit
alternate ad-hoc error shapes for specific conditions; those are noted in
the relevant operation descriptions.

FilesLargeDiffStrategy.description:
User-facing toggle in Settings. Picked from the `SwiftUI` Picker;
serialized through to the daemon on each request.

HarnessCodeLanguage.description:
Compact enum of source languages the diff renderer recognizes. Kept narrow
on purpose: tokenizers only exist for these; anything else falls through to
the diff-only renderer (no syntax highlighting).

HookIntegrationDescriptor.description: One user-visible hook interception point for signal pickup.

ImproverTarget.description: Canonical writeable targets for improver patches.

IssueCode.description: Stable internal identity for a classified issue family.

IssueSeverity.description: Severity level of an observed issue, ordered for filtering.

LocalCloneListEntry.description: One row in the Settings-panel projection of the clones registry.

ManagedAgentKind.description: Transport family for a daemon-managed agent reference.

ManagedAgentSnapshotSchema.description:
Documented wire shape of [`ManagedAgentSnapshot`]. utoipa cannot override an
enum variant's inner type, and the `Acp` variant hand-serializes its identity
fields, so this mirror points that variant at [`AcpAgentSnapshotSchema`]. It
is referenced from the handlers via `body = ManagedAgentSnapshotSchema`.

OkResponse.description:
Minimal success envelope for endpoints that acknowledge with `{"ok": true}`
and carry no other payload.

PendingLeaderTransfer.description: A pending leadership transfer initiated by a non-leader actor.

oneOf.description: A system SF Symbol identified by name (e.g. `magnifyingglass.circle.fill`).
An image baked into the app's asset catalog.

PersonaSymbol.description: Icon source for a persona, supporting system SF Symbols or bundled assets.

ReadinessResponse.description:
Lightweight readiness probe response.

Returned by `GET /v1/ready`. Confirms the daemon is serving HTTP, the
caller is authenticated, and the backing storage slot is wired up - but
intentionally avoids any database query so short-lived CLI invocations can
verify readiness cheaply.

ReviewClaim.description: Set of reviewers currently holding or having completed a claim on the task.

ReviewConsensus.description:
Aggregated quorum consensus once `required_consensus` distinct-runtime
reviewers have submitted compatible verdicts.

ReviewFile.description:
Metadata for one file inside a PR. No patch body here - patches arrive
via the separate `patch` endpoint (REST or local-clone diff).

ReviewFilePatch.description: One file's patch body + metadata produced by either REST or local clone.

ReviewFileServedBy.description: Annotates which path produced a patch body so the UI can label provenance.

ReviewFileViewedOutcome.description:
Outcome per path. The Monitor uses this to reconcile its optimistic UI:
`Updated` confirms the flip, `Drifted` accepts the daemon's current state,
`Failed` rolls back.

ReviewFilesViewedResult.description: One result row inside the response.

ReviewFilesViewedTarget.description: One target within a viewed-state request.

ReviewImageMime.description: Recognized image-content MIME types we'll preview inline.

ReviewItemFlags.description: Per-PR state flags bundled into at most 3 booleans.

ReviewPoint.description: A single numbered review point the worker may agree to or dispute.

ReviewTargetFlags.description: State flags embedded in [`ReviewTarget`] (at most 3 booleans).

ReviewVerdict.description: Verdict a reviewer chooses on submission.

ReviewerEntry.description: One entry in a task's reviewer claim.

ReviewsFilesBlobRequest.description: Request the bytes for one image blob by repository node id + git OID.

ReviewsFilesBlobResponse.description:
Response carrying the blob bytes (base64-encoded for JSON transport) +
metadata + a per-call rate-limit snapshot.

ReviewsFilesListRequest.description: Request a list of changed files for a single pull request.

ReviewsFilesListResponse.description: Response shape for a files-list call.

base_ref_oid.description:
Merge-base OID for the PR. Required for the local-clone diff path
to compute `base..head` patches.

head_ref_name.description:
PR's source branch name (e.g. `renovate/foo`). Used by the local-clone
path so `ensure_clone` fetches the right ref instead of always
opening `refs/heads/main`.

pagination_complete.description:
`true` when the pagination loop drained every page from GitHub.
`false` when the loop bailed out under `FILES_PAGE_CAP` while
GitHub still had `hasNextPage == true` - the response is partial
and the caller should surface a warning. Defaults to `true` for
backwards compatibility with older callers that don't read this
field.

repository_full_name.description:
`owner/name` of the repository the PR lives in. Lets the Monitor
hand the patch request a clone target without re-querying GraphQL.

ReviewsFilesPatchRequest.description:
Batched patch request for one PR. The caller supplies the head ref oid it
believes it's still on; the daemon compares against the current head and
returns `drifted: true` with the fresh oid if a force-push intervened.

base_ref_name.description:
PR base branch name. When present, the local clone fetches it directly
before computing the expected base/head OID diff.

base_ref_oid_expected.description:
Merge-base OID against which to compute the diff. Required for the
local-clone path; when absent the handler falls back to REST.

head_ref_name.description:
PR's source branch name (e.g. `renovate/foo`). When present, the
local-clone runtime fetches that ref directly instead of the
daemon's default-branch fallback.

oneOf.description:
User's `filesLargeDiffStrategy` choice from Settings. Daemon honors
`ForceGitHubRest` by skipping the local-clone runtime entirely.
Defaults to `AutoLocalClone` for callers that don't supply it.

number.description:
GitHub PR number (the integer in `pulls/{n}/files`). Required for
the REST path; when absent, the daemon can only route to the
local-clone path (which uses GitHub's synthetic
`refs/pull/<number>/head` ref for forks + same-repo PR branches).

repository_full_name.description:
Owner/name of the repository the PR lives in. When present, the
daemon can route the patch fetch through the local-clone runtime
(zero-rate-limit) or the REST path.

ReviewsFilesPatchResponse.description: Response carrying the per-path patches plus drift detection.

ReviewsFilesViewedRequest.description: Request to flip viewed-state on one or more paths within a PR.

ReviewsPolicyRunMetrics.description:
Aggregate status and trigger counts for the runs in a history response.
Mirrors the runtime metrics summary so the Monitor app can render totals
without re-deriving them from the run list.

ReviewsPolicyTimelineEntry.description:
A single structured entry in a policy run timeline export, flattened from
the recorded step list across the response's runs.

viewer_login.description:
GitHub login of the authenticated viewer for "(you)" reviewer and
"Commenting as @viewer" UI copy. `None` means lookup failed.

ReviewsRateLimitSnapshot.description:
Lightweight echo of the rate-limit budget at the time of the response.
The Monitor uses this to surface a cooling banner without polling a
separate endpoint.

ReviewsRequestReviewRequest.description:
Re-request a fresh review from a specific GitHub login on each target
pull request. Mirrors GitHub's "Re-request review" affordance: when a
reviewer has already submitted a review (approved, dismissed, or
requested changes), this drops them back into the requested-reviewers
list so they get notified to look again.

pull_request_id.description:
PR cache key — the daemon drains the per-PR timeline cache
after a successful mutation so the next fetch reflects the new
`isResolved` state.

RuntimeCapabilities.description: Serializable runtime capability metadata exposed to daemon clients.

RuntimeSessionResolutionResponse.description:
Wire-level outcome of a runtime-session lookup.

Returned by `GET /v1/runtime-sessions/resolve`. `resolved` is `None` when
no live agent matches; `Some` carries the single unambiguous match. The
daemon surfaces ambiguity as a `session_ambiguous` error instead of
populating this response with multiple entries.

SessionAdHocError.description:
Ad-hoc error body emitted by a few session endpoints that predate the
standard [`DaemonErrorBody`] envelope. It always carries a short string
`error` tag or message; some responses add variant-specific fields, which
the owning operation documents. The schema leaves additional properties
open so those variant fields validate.

error.description:
Error tag or message, for example `already-attached` or
`session not found`.

persona.description: Persona identifier to resolve and attach to the agent registration.

SessionMetrics.description: Lightweight rollup metrics for session summaries.

SessionRole.description: Role an agent holds within a session.

SessionSignalRecord.description: A signal visible within a multi-agent session.

SessionSignalStatus.description: Session-visible signal status for CLI and daemon rendering.

SessionState.description: Main versioned state document for a multi-agent orchestration session.

adopted_at.description: Timestamp when this session was adopted from an external origin.

agents.description: Registered agents keyed by agent ID.

archived_at.description: Timestamp when the session was archived.

branch_ref.description: Git branch owned by this session (`harness/<sid>`).

external_origin.description: Path of the external session directory this session was adopted from.

leader_id.description: Agent ID of the current leader.

metrics.description: Cached counts for fast daemon and UI list rendering.

observe_id.description: Observe state identifier associated with this session.

oneOf.description: Pending leadership transfer request awaiting confirmation.

shared_path.description: Per-session shared directory for cross-agent artefacts.

state_version.description: Monotonically increasing counter for optimistic concurrency.

tasks.description: Work items keyed by task ID.

Signal.description: A signal sent to an agent session.

TaskCheckpointSummary.description: Snapshot of the latest checkpoint for a task.

TaskNote.description: A note attached to a work item status transition.

TaskQueuePolicy.description:
Whether a queued task can move to another free worker before its selected
worker becomes available.

TaskSeverity.description: Severity level for a work item.

TaskSource.description: Source that introduced a work item.

WorkItem.description: A work item tracked within a session.

oneOf.description: Metadata for the awaiting-review queue entry.
Closed quorum consensus, set once `required_consensus` reviewers agree.

deleted_at.description:
Tombstone timestamp for tasks deleted from active session views while
preserving their historical identity and timeline.

oneOf.description: Active reviewer claim, including distinct-runtime reviewer entries.

review_history.description:
Per-round consensus history: each entry is the merged-and-responded
consensus from one completed round, pushed here before
`task.consensus` is cleared so per-point agree/dispute state and
worker notes survive across rounds.

review_round.description: Review round counter; increments each time a reworked task goes back to review.

suggested_persona.description: Persona hint to bias routing when assigning to a worker.

RemoteAuthRequired.description: Missing, invalid, or unauthorized daemon credentials

RemoteRequestUriTooLong.description: Request URI exceeds the configured remote limit

RemoteRequestBodyTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds the configured remote limit

RemoteRequestHeadersTooLarge.description: Request headers exceed the configured remote limit

RemoteRequestThrottled.description: Remote request or connection concurrency limit reached

RemoteServiceUnavailable.description: Remote auth store or request limits unavailable

RemoteRequestTimedOut.description: Remote request exceeded the configured timeout
